items.content:
President Trump yesterday:

“If the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate … I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen … for $5,000.”

Number of adult US citizens: 245 million

Cost: $1.2 trillion

But unlike a profitable company, the federal government has no earnings from which to pay a dividend.

Instead, it's running a deficit of $2 trillion.

So where would the money come from?

Absent spending cuts or new revenues, we’d have to borrow it - adding another $1.2 trillion to the national debt.

And what would that do to inflation?

We've seen this movie before. The covid stimulus programs were funded with borrowed money - pushing inflation above 9%, the highest level in 40 years.
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 10, 2026

items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: The 10-year Treasury Yield has surged above 4.9%, the highest level since 2023. They're gonna need a much bigger "buyback."
items.content:
The 10-year Treasury Yield has surged above 4.9%, the highest level since 2023.

They're gonna need a much bigger "buyback."Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello)The Treasury Department is calling this a “debt buyback.”

But they’re not reducing the debt.

They’re running huge deficits, buying back old bonds, and issuing even more new ones.

This is debt reshuffling, not debt reduction.—  https://x.com/charliebilello/status/2090074621865308482
